- **Q: How does Google's open-source Elephant-Goldfish Model (EGM) compare to GitHub Spec Kit and Kiro Specs, and how do I migrate off retiring `claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929` (Nov 30) and `gemini-2.5-pro`/`flash` (Dec 1) before production requests fail?**
  - **Answer:** Unlike GitHub Spec Kit or Kiro Specs (which rely primarily on human review between phases), Google's Apache-2.0 **Elephant-Goldfish Model (EGM)** uses a stateful "Elephant" session to draft the spec (`/egm-brainstorm`, `/egm-draft`) and spawns 5 sequential stages of stateless, zero-context "Goldfish" subagents (`/egm-review`) to attack the spec before any code is written.
